theorems.statement: For a finite rational-valuation Newton jet whose polynomial coefficients depend affinely on rational parameters, every finite declared rational-root Newton schedule has a validity set given by a finite Boolean combination of rational affine equalities and non-equalities. Contact orders and selected scales are constant on the induced affine-hyperplane strata, and frozen scheduled substitution preserves affine dependence.

negative_boundaries.statement: A multiple-root schedule-valid set may have positive codimension and need not contain an ordinary open neighborhood.
T59 certifies declared rational roots/multiplicities/scales; it does not prove that a global root-selector rule continues to choose the same root.
The promoted constructibility theorem assumes coefficients affine over rational parameters.
T59 does not promote a generic multi-generator algebraic coefficient field.
Finite declared schedule validity is not a complete Puiseux-series algorithm or termination theorem.
Finite Boolean combinations of affine equalities/non-equalities need not be convex or open.
Affine determinant/Taylor coefficient cancellation remains algebraic compression and is not signed branch-mass interference.
